limitations: The avatar and banner URL timestamps are provider resource times; a live detector still depends on its first successful poll.
The first-wave and second-wave FDVs are historical candle approximations, not executable buy prices.
No retained snapshot proves the exact time Elon followed @bot.
No candidate wallet or X account in this replay is promoted to a verified profitable KOL.
Later exact-CA posts from @CryptoBitxin and @munburanketto occurred after the first-wave peak and are posthoc propagation, not discovery evidence.
A profile catalyst identifies a narrative; it does not by itself bind the winning contract address.
